government.body: Dozeles Cleaning is proud to offer top-tier cleaning services tailored specifically for government contracts. With over 20 years of experience, we understand the unique requirements and high standards demanded by government facilities. We are a Certified Small Business (Cert. faqs.q: How do I book a cleaning service with Dozeles Cleaning?
faqs.a: Booking a cleaning service with Dozeles Cleaning is simple and straightforward. You can contact us via phone, email, or through our website's contact form. Our team will assist you in selecting the right service for your needs, scheduling a convenient time, and providing a transparent quote. We pride ourselves on punctuality and flexibility, ensuring that your cleaning appointment fits seamlessly into your busy schedule.

Dozeles Cleaning proudly serves the San Francisco Bay Area, offering comprehensive cleaning services to both residential and commercial clients. From bustling urban centers to quieter suburban neighborhoods, we are committed to delivering top-notch cleaning services wherever you are located.

faqs.q: What types of cleaning services do you offer?
faqs.a: We offer a wide range of cleaning services: residential cleaning, commercial cleaning, janitorial services, government facility cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning, post-construction cleaning, and Airbnb cleaning and management. Each service is tailored to ensure thorough and effective cleaning, using eco-friendly products and advanced techniques.

faqs.q: What should I expect during my first cleaning appointment?
faqs.a: Our team will arrive on time, equipped with all necessary cleaning supplies and equipment. We will conduct a walkthrough of your space to understand your specific needs and preferences, then clean thoroughly, focusing on high-traffic areas and hard-to-reach spots. We use eco-friendly products and HEPA filters, and after the cleaning we review the results with you to ensure complete satisfaction.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept a variety of payment methods, including major credit cards, debit cards, and electronic bank transfers. For regular clients, we also offer the option of setting up automatic payments to streamline the billing process.

faqs.q: When will I receive my invoice, and what is the payment due date?
faqs.a: Invoices are typically generated and sent within 24 hours after the completion of each service via email, with a detailed breakdown of the services provided. Payment is generally due within 14 days of the invoice date. For recurring clients, invoices can be issued monthly.

faqs.q: Are there any late fees for overdue payments?
faqs.a: If payment is not received within 14 days from the invoice date, a late fee of 5% of the total invoice amount will be added. If you anticipate any difficulty making a timely payment, please contact our billing department as soon as possible.

faqs.q: Can I set up a recurring payment plan for regular cleaning services?
faqs.a: Absolutely! Recurring payment plans can be arranged on a weekly, biweekly, or monthly basis, depending on your cleaning schedule. Payments are processed automatically for a hassle-free experience. Contact our billing department to set this up.
